local_inventory_contract.threading: One background serial scan per plugin instance; repeat requests rejected busy; results on main thread; native 4s cooperative deadline, startup 5s terminal timeout; detach cancels exactly once and ignores late completion.
local_inventory_contract.validation: Every read checks current manifest and installed record without positive cache. Lowercase ASCII id, numeric dotted staged version domain, exact id/version/entry/channel consistency, bounded UTF-8 JSON and UTF-16 strings, no symlink at inspected paths, regular entry/icon and path confinement.
local_inventory_contract.version_domain: 1-8 decimal components of 1-9 digits each; exact string equality only, no comparison; prerelease/underscore/overflow rejected, no migration.
local_inventory_contract.scope_note: Validated local metadata only. Non-empty inventory does not imply executable content or full runtime availability. Private local filesystem checks are not cryptographic authenticity or an atomic snapshot against hostile concurrent mutation.

renderer_contract.ready_semantics: Current verified local main document committed; DOM/CSS/image/interaction are separate real-OS test evidence.

capability.note: foundation preserves initialize compatibility; false loading flags refer to complete openMini/openWeb links, downloads/installation/Bridge, which remain unsupported.

renderer_contract.validation: Every resource revalidates the bound miniId/version/entry and current manifest/record channel consistency, regular file and symlink-free anchored path. One strict UTF-8 percent decode, no encoded slash/backslash/percent, authority userinfo/port/query or cross-package access; no network fallback.
renderer_contract.identity_change: A current-generation resource identity failure fails/stops the view. Ordinary missing image is rejected without failing the whole ready page. Reload remains bound to original version/entry; new identity requires explicit new view.
renderer_contract.resource_bounds: At most four active readers per view, 8MiB each, 4s cooperative deadline and zero wait overflow rejection; slot held through response stream/immutable bytes release. Not a whole-WebView memory bound.
renderer_contract.lifecycle: Single identity worker with cancellation/latest pending work, new WebView per cross-document navigation/reload/back, native same-package history, fragment changes keep committed phase. Close/detach and old generation callbacks cannot own a new navigation.
renderer_contract.ios_csp_difference: Custom scheme local JS/CSS/image use stmini: scheme CSP sources, not exact-host CSP. The sole scheme handler still enforces exact current miniId host/path/identity. Content rules block tested remote schemes.
renderer_contract.network_claim: Real OS tests cover listed main navigation, remote script/image/frame/fetch/XHR/WebSocket/form and file/content/data/blob/new-window attempts with local JS execution and loopback positive control. No claim that CSP/interception closes all browser channels; WebRTC/UDP/DNS and physical devices are unverified.
renderer_contract.product_boundary: Default original homepage; no Mini URL, hidden switch or automatic page open. No download, installation, native JavaScript bridge, account injection or new production permission. Test-only fixture/targets are not production assets.
renderer_contract.android_csp: Standard self sources enforce the current exact document origin, including staged IDs with underscore that are invalid CSP host-source tokens. blockNetworkLoads remains true and the local handler has no fallback.
renderer_contract.android_composition: Explicit hybrid composition: PlatformViewLink + AndroidViewSurface + initExpensiveAndroidView, with both framework and SDK creation listeners, native focus and layout direction updates. Native DOM/commit alone is insufficient evidence that the Flutter composition painted.
